name: WhosStudio.co
notes: About three quarters of my views came from people who don't follow me yet, and Reels reached almost all of them.
Roughly 1 in 10 viewers visited my profile, and about 1 in 80 profile visits ended in an order.
Four in five followers are 18 to 34, and almost 80% are in India.

next_steps.title: Make more Reels like my best ones
next_steps.why: Reels reached almost every account that found the shop (about 23K of 23.9K viewers), and my top four pieces each got 2K to 2.6K views.
next_steps.do: Post Reels more regularly, repeat the formats of my top four, and end each one by saying how to order.
next_steps.track: Reels reach and profile visits in my next 90-day snapshot.

next_steps.title: Turn more viewers into profile visits
next_steps.why: About 1 in 10 viewers visits my profile.
next_steps.do: Open each Reel with a quick hook that shows what I make, and keep the bio to one clear line about the shop.
next_steps.track: Profile visits divided by viewers (10.5% now).

next_steps.title: Make ordering obvious
next_steps.why: About 1 in 80 profile visits ends in an order, and 146 people tapped the bio link.
next_steps.do: Pin a post with prices and how to order, add highlights for delivery and FAQs, and say "DM to order" in the bio.
next_steps.track: Orders divided by profile visits (1.2% now).

next_steps.title: Keep customers coming back
next_steps.why: Only a quarter of my views come from followers, and I have 187 followers, so each one is worth keeping.
next_steps.do: Share new pieces and behind-the-scenes in Stories, add a thank-you note to every order, and invite buyers to follow.
next_steps.track: Repeat-buyer share, once I log every order.

next_steps.title: Measure the missing steps
next_steps.do: Log every order with its date, product and where the customer found me, and count buying DMs each week.
next_steps.track: Monthly trends, repeat rate and a DM step in the funnel.
